Speaker: Jordan Ellis
Text: Thanks for your time today. How do you manage your energy account?

Speaker: Daniel Reyes
Text: I'm on a fixed tariff and I send readings every month without fail. I'm quite organised about that sort of thing.

Speaker: Jordan Ellis
Text: Tell me about the last reading you sent.

Speaker: Daniel Reyes
Text: That was the start of this month. I take a photo of the meter first, every time, then type it in. Last year they once said my reading was wrong and the photo sorted it out in one email.

Speaker: Jordan Ellis
Text: Have you ever had an estimated bill?

Speaker: Daniel Reyes
Text: Once, when we moved in. It was based on the previous owners and far too high. I sent a reading straight away and it was fixed in a couple of days.

Speaker: Jordan Ellis
Text: What would make sending a reading easier?

Speaker: Daniel Reyes
Text: Being able to upload the photo instead of typing the numbers. I'd use that.
